recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-12311 unless a future work-group decision changes the policy for semantic ordering in profiles.
issue_request: FHIR-12311 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request to add a way for ElementDefinition to indicate when the order of a repeating element has meaning. The accepted resolution specified a 0..1 string element named orderMeaning, with absence meaning no order semantics, and limits on profiles introducing ordering meaning when the base type lacks it.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 11203, represented in git by 8c3813303ed3c8d0e5efe695af4639ec6a9ecf9a, which added ElementDefinition.orderMeaning to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml with the requested type, definition, and comments.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active build content in source/fhir.ini and is marked normative. Current source still has ElementDefinition.orderMeaning as 0..1 string with the requested definition and restriction text, and the FHIR model definition includes orderMeaning as FHIR.string. Community searches found no conflicting later Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative source already implements the Jira resolution. A no-change audit commit was published to the combined branch.

related_jiras.note: Implemented in the same historical svn revision with adjacent ordering guidance, but it concerns broader reliability of repeating-field order and was not independently decided here.
